notes.title: Update 0.22.0
notes.content:
Hello, players! At long last, the silver-haired head maid, Sakuya Izayoi, makes her debut in Dreamy Duels with the release of version 0.22.0! With her power to manipulate time, Sakuya excels at drawing cards quickly and reducing their cost, allowing her to unleash a flurry of plays in a single turn to seize victory.

For detailed update information, please visit our official website: https://thg.igsk.fun/

notes.title: Fix 0.21.1
notes.content:
[h1]Editor[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where cards with event effects could not be copied properly.
[*] Fixed an issue where cards with effects that include target conditions could not be copied properly.
[*] Fixed an issue where nodes with variable-length parameters had incorrect connection positions after being copied.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.21.0
notes.content:
Hello, players! In this update, we've added the ability to copy buffs when duplicating cards. We hope this will reduce the workload when creating a large number of buff-related cards. Additionally, we've supplemented events related to changes in buff properties.

For detailed update information, please visit our official website: https://thg.igsk.fun/

notes.title: Update 0.20.0
notes.content:
Hello, players! Long time no see. In this update, we’ve added a Popularity Mode to the Workshop's card pool rankings. This mode considers the recency and relevance of positive ratings to showcase the latest and most popular card pools, ensuring that older, highly-rated pools no longer dominate the rankings indefinitely.

Additionally, we’ve introduced several new nodes related to events and mapping sets, giving players more tools to create unique cards!

Event-related nodes include:
[list]
[*] Retrieving a sub-event or parent event of a given event
[*] Identifying the event chain that an event belongs to
[*] Tracking events triggered during and after the occurrence of a specific event
[/list]

These enhancements will allow players to fine-tune their card effects and chain reactions more effectively, enabling deeper DIY customization.

For detailed update information, please visit our official website: https://thg.igsk.fun/

notes.title: Fix v0.19.1
notes.content:
[h1]Workshop[/h1]
[list]
[*] The Workshop now defaults to displaying the highest-rated card pools.
[*] Fixed an issue where card pools on the Popular page of the Workshop could not be opened.
[*] Fixed an issue where the rankings on the Highest-Rated page were displayed incorrectly, as well as other pages incorrectly showing rankings.
[/list]

notes.title: Fix 0.18.8
notes.content:
[h1]Editor[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where clicking the close button in the card pool selection interface would cause the interface to freeze.
[*] Fixed an issue where the value of variable named "variable name" of the "Get Variable" node could reset when opening a card.
[*] Fixed an issue where rendering the audio waveform would fail if the audio sample height was set to 0.
[*] Fixed a crash caused by importing unreadable audio files.
[*] Fixed an issue where the effects panel displayed incorrectly.
[*] Added an "original value" variable to the "Set Max Gem Value" and "Set Gem Value" events.
[/list]
[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed some animation logic to prevent the game from freezing due to certain special animation.
[*] Fixed an issue where it was still possible to click the mulligan options after confirming the mulligan.
[*] Fixed an issue where stitched card define had no sound effects.
[/list]
[h1]UI[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the chat text box in the room would only send text when the line break was at the end.
[/list]
[h1]Workshop[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where some card pools could not be uploaded to the Steam Workshop.
[/list]

notes.title: Fix v0.18.5
notes.content:
[h1]Editor[/h1]
[list]
[*] Buff effects can now have their colors adjusted.
[*] Fixed the issue where morph events did not output variables.
[*] Fixed the issue where spell damage or damage reduction could not be set in card define.
[/list]

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where seal did not remove stealth, shield, and shackle.
[*] Fixed the issue where spell damage caused by non-spell cards was being calculated twice.
[/list]

[h1]Workshop[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where downloading a Workshop card pool did not repair its contents, making it unreadable.
[*] Fixed the issue where Workshop card pool covers were not downloaded correctly to the local storage, but saved in the cache instead.
[/list]

notes.title: Fix 0.18.4
notes.content:
[h1]Battle[/h1]

[list]
[*] Now, when a card is played, it will attempt to trigger all its active effects.
[/list]
[h1]UI[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the buff name or description would be empty, causing errors in buff display during matches.
[/list]
[h1]Editor[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added related nodes for creating derivative card definitions during matches.
[*] Added nodes for retrieving and checking the card pool a card belongs to.
[*] Now buffs can modify the tags a card possesses.
[*] Fixed an issue where card images could not be resized correctly, leading to images being too large to upload.
[/list]
[h1]Others[/h1]

[list]
[*] After the game account status becomes invalid, attempting to execute network-related functions will now return to the main interface and prompt a login status invalid message.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 0.18.3
notes.content:
[h1]Editor[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where, after setting the card or buff image and saving the card pool, the image path would be incorrect, leading to the inability to upload to the Workshop or re-import the card pool. For card pools that have already encountered this error, re-saving the card pool will fix the related errors.
[*] Fixed issues where the Action Editor and Rule Editor were unusable.
[*] Fixed an issue where card pools in the new format could not be used for online games.
[/list]

[h1]Cards[/h1]
[list]
[] Changed the trigger timing in the descriptions of Minoriko Aki and Shizuha Aki from "after the end of the turn" to "at the end of the turn".
[] Fixed an issue where Arcane Knowledge would reveal non-spell cards.
[*] Fixed an issue in the classic card pool where Letty Whiterock's effect would be canceled within the same turn after the player used a skill.
[/list]

[h1]Battle[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the hero's current health would be reduced by double the value the first time their health decreases without taking damage.
[/list]

notes.title: Fix 0.17.4
notes.content:
[h1]Duel[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where returning a servant to hand when the hand is full would not destroy the servant.
[*] Fixed an issue where the AI using the Medicine Seller would cause errors.
[*] Fixed an issue where a card might cause an error upon death due to attempting to play a sound effect.
[*] The same sound effect played within the same frame will no longer stack.
[*] Adjusted AI attack logic to address situations where the AI would not attack.
[*] Fixed an issue where a servant with First Strike would not have its stun removed at the end of the turn if it was stunned without attacking.
[/list]

[h1]Cards[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Koishi Komeiji’s effect would trigger on cards with no target, causing slow animations.
[*] Fixed an issue where Koishi Komeiji’s attack effect lacked special effects.
[*] Fixed an issue where using Dream Of Prosperity multiple times in one turn would result in incorrect hand state at the end of the turn.
[*] Fixed an issue where summoned Rat were not considered Nazrin's cards.
[*] Adjusted the logic for the disappearance of classic card pools and the implementation of True Moon.
[*] Fixed visual effect issues for the following cards in the classic card pool:
[*] Neutral: Flame Fairy, Yukari Yakumo, Mystia, Reisen Udongein Inaba
[*] Youmu: The Fifth Sign Of Decay, Slash Of Eternity
[*] Sanae: Miracle Of Tempest
[*] Rin: Wisp
[/list]

notes.title: Fix 0.16.7
notes.content:
Dear Players,

In version 0.16.7, we have fixed some issues that were affecting normal gameplay.

Editor:
Fixed an issue where the "Deal damage or spell damage split among" node would cause errors and crash when dealing damage to shielded minions.
Fixed an issue where the "Mass move to Delay" event was executed incorrectly.

Other:
Fixed an issue on the Linux platform where StreamingAssets could not be correctly read, preventing access to the main interface.
